name: io.github.BourbonDog/amicus
title: Amicus
description: Multi-model council for Claude: review your work or do a task, judged blind. Or fork any model.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter API key (recommended multi-model route). Optional when a provider key is configured via 'amicus setup' (~/.config/amicus/.env) or OpenCode auth.json.

environmentVariables.name: AMICUS_SKIP_POSTINSTALL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 when a plugin/client manages registration itself (skips npm postinstall side effects).
